item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine launched a drone strike that killed a worker at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant and hit a missile-fuel plant in St Petersburg, while Russia continued missile and drone attacks on Ukrainian power facilities and the Northern Bridge. Russia began rationing petrol after Ukrainian strikes damaged its second-largest refinery in Saratov, prompting Rosneft to cap sales, and a Russian FPV drone wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. Trilateral peace talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine are underway in Abu Dhabi. A senior US soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of spying for Russia. 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Gunfire struck tents at the Rafah displacement site in Gaza as aid teams prepared for winter storms, while Israeli fire in the Gaza Strip killed seven people, including a 13-year-old boy. Israeli forces beat a Palestinian university president during an IDF raid in the West Bank and shot dead a 14-year-old boy there, and movement restrictions continue to hamper health actors such as MSF. The Israeli prime minister's office allowed winter supplies to enter Gaza but said Hamas must disarm before reconstruction can proceed. Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton visited Gaza aid facilities on the Egyptian side of the Rafah crossing. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Israeli forces continued cross-border activity, returning an Israeli man who entered Lebanon and expanding a 90 km road network and new bases while conducting airstrikes on Qantara and shelling that wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Hezbollah persisted in firing artillery at Israeli positions and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. France opened a probe into alleged Israeli war crimes and protests against Israeli attacks occurred in Sweden. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

France warned of a response to a cyberattack on supermarkets that it blamed on Iran. The conflict has already caused 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, sharpening front-line fighting. Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh and a Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children; a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. The coalition intercepted a cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina, and Saudi Arabia shot down missiles fired at Riyadh after a Houthi attack on the East-West pipeline. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iran-linked drones struck the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power, and Iraqi forces responded with airstrikes on three suspected militants and a tunnel in Kirkuk's Zghaitun Valley. Iraqi officials identified the launch site of the Khor Mor attack and said militia leaders are seeking Chinese and Russian air defenses, prompting deployment of air defenses to fifty locations. Baghdad reopened the Sheeb border crossing with Iran after a three-week closure and agreed to withdraw Turkish forces from the Zilkan base by the end of 2026. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in a Beirut apartment. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024.

item.description:

A senior RSF commander defected to the army after 13 years, and Pakistan signed a 1.5 billion-dollar security cooperation deal with Sudan. Drones now account for two thirds of child casualties in the conflict. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: The Sahel insurgency: the situation
item.description:

In Mali, Africa Corps drones are conducting lethal strikes and rival terror groups are devastating the Sahel, and Malian forces recaptured Kidal with Russian electronic-warfare vehicles operating there. Russian influence expanded as Russia helped foil a coup in Niger, prompting EU concern over Algerian and Russian troop deployments in Niger, and a €46 million West African intelligence and cyber contract was awarded to Mer Group. Burkina Faso, after aligning with Russia, partnered with another Western state on its 36th reunification anniversary. The conflict still generates high fatalities, with 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

A reported bandit leader, Kachalla Bello, was killed in Katsina, and gunmen have kidnapped and later released a mother and three sons after a ransom demand.
